# Dealer Interest

Level D data — records third-party interest in estate assets (art dealers, property investors, collectors). Privacy-controlled. Managed via proxy authorisation

Source: [`v3/dealer-interest.json`](../../v3/dealer-interest.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/dealer-interest.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this dealer interest record within the INHERIT document |
| `interestedParty` | [InterestedParty](#def-InterestedParty) | yes | The third party expressing interest in estate assets |
| `assets` | array of [AssetInterestItem](#def-AssetInterestItem) | | Specific assets or properties the interested party wants to acquire |
| `collection` | [CollectionInterest](#def-CollectionInterest) | | Interest in a collection of assets as a whole |
| `offerStatus` | one of `standing_interest`, `verbal_offer`, `written_offer`, `formal_valuation`, `conditional_offer`, `accepted`, `declined`, `expired`, `withdrawn` | yes | Current status of the offer or expression of interest |
| `offerDetails` | [OfferDetails](#def-OfferDetails) | | Details of a specific offer, if one has been made |
| `testatorDisposition` | one of `willing_to_sell`, `prefer_not_to_sell`, `hold_for_executor`, `deferred_to_family`, `promised_to_institution`, `undecided` | | The testator's disposition towards selling this asset |
| `linkedBequestId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to a Bequest.id if this asset is also subject to a bequest. A dealer interest and a bequest may conflict |
| `privacyLevel` | one of `testator_only`, `proxy_visible`, `executor_visible`, `all_parties` | yes | Who may see this dealer interest record. Privacy is critical — the testator may not want family to know about dealer approaches |
| `communicationInitiatedBy` | one of `buyer`, `testator`, `proxy`, `executor` | | Who initiated the communication about this potential transaction |
| `managedByProxyId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the ProxyAuthorisation.id that governs this dealer interest — the proxy managing the negotiation |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this dealer interest |
| `verificationResult` | `object` | | The outcome of a verification inspection — records whether the item matched its listed condition and any price adjustments |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.

## Definitions

<a id="def-AssetInterestItem"></a>

### AssetInterestItem

A specific asset or property that the interested party wants to acquire

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `assetId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to an Asset.id |
| `propertyId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to a Property.id |
| `interestLevel` | one of `exploratory`, `moderate`, `strong`, `committed` | | How strong the interested party's intent is |

<a id="def-CollectionInterest"></a>

### CollectionInterest

Interest in a collection of assets or properties as a whole, rather than individual items

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | | Name of the collection |
| `assetIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | Asset IDs that make up this collection |
| `propertyIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | Property IDs that make up this collection |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional notes about the collection interest |

<a id="def-InterestedParty"></a>

### InterestedParty

A third party expressing interest in purchasing or acquiring estate assets

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `personId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to a Person.id if the interested party is an individual in the people array |
| `personIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced person |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Name of the interested party — individual or organisation |
| `type` | one of `art_dealer`, `antique_dealer`, `property_investor`, `auction_house`, `gallery`, `private_collector`, `museum`, `institution`, `charity`, `developer`, `fund_manager`, `family_office`, `estate_agent`, `legal_practice`, `other` | yes | The type of interested party |
| `contactDetails` | `string` | | Contact details for the interested party |
| `organisationId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to an Organisation.id if the interested party is a known organisation. Mutually exclusive with personId |
| `organisationIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced organisation |

<a id="def-OfferDetails"></a>

### OfferDetails

Details of a specific offer made by the interested party

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `amount` | [Money](common/money.md) | | The offer amount in minor currency units |
| `conditions` | array of `string` | | Conditions attached to the offer |
| `validUntil` | `string` (date) | | Date the offer expires |
| `offerDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the offer was made |
| `documentRef` | `string` | | Reference to the document containing the offer |
| `offerTerms` | `string` | | Terms and conditions of the offer |
| `inspectionRequired` | `boolean` | | Whether a physical inspection is required before the offer can be finalised |
| `inspectionDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the inspection is scheduled or took place |
